import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastReader fr = new FastReader(System.in);
        
        String line1 = fr.nextLine();
        if (line1 == null) return;
        String[] nk = line1.split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(nk[0]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(nk[1]);
        
        String line2 = fr.nextLine();
        if (line2 == null) return;
        String[] lStr = line2.split(" ");
        int[] l = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            l[i] = (int)(Long.parseLong(lStr[i]) % k);
        }
        
        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(l[0]);
            return;
        }
        
        int mid = n / 2;
        int[] l1 = new int[mid];
        int[] l2 = new int[n - mid];
        for (int i = 0; i < mid; i++) l1[i] = l[i];
        for (int i = mid; i < n; i++) l2[i - mid] = l[i];
        
        Set<Integer> s = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> s1 = new HashSet<>();
        
        // Process first half
        for (int i = 0; i < mid; i++) {
            Set<Integer> nextS = new HashSet<>();
            for (int j : s) {
                nextS.add((j + l1[i]) % k);
            }
            s.add(l1[i]);
            s.addAll(nextS);
        }
        
        // Process second half
        for (int i = 0; i < n - mid; i++) {
            Set<Integer> nextS1 = new HashSet<>();
            for (int j : s1) {
                nextS1.add((j + l2[i]) % k);
            }
            s1.add(l2[i]);
            s1.addAll(nextS1);
        }
        
        List<Integer> listS = new ArrayList<>(s);
        List<Integer> listS1 = new ArrayList<>(s1);
        Collections.sort(listS);
        Collections.sort(listS1);
        
        int ans = 0;
        if (!listS.isEmpty()) ans = Math.max(ans, listS.get(listS.size() - 1));
        if (!listS1.isEmpty()) ans = Math.max(ans, listS1.get(listS1.size() - 1));
        
        for (int valS : listS) {
            int target = k - 1 - valS;
            int ind = binarySearchCount(listS1, target);
            if (ind > 0) {
                int r = listS1.get(ind - 1);
                ans = Math.max(ans, (r + valS) % k);
            }
            if (!listS1.isEmpty()) {
                int rt = listS1.get(listS1.size() - 1);
                ans = Math.max(ans, (valS + rt) % k);
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
    
    private static int binarySearchCount(List<Integer> arr, int key) {
        int left = 0;
        int right = arr.size() - 1;
        int count = 0;
        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (arr.get(mid) <= key) {
                count = mid + 1;
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
    
    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;
        
        public FastReader(InputStream in) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        }
        
        public String nextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
    }
}
